title: Get started with essential8
text: essential8 computes component composite Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) cardiovascular health scores. current implementation scores adults aged 20 years older using American Heart Association’s 2022 definition. Pediatric scoring yet available. vignette shows basic complete-data workflow. See ?score_le8 full input contract scoring details.

title: Get started with essential8
text: Supply one row per person. example uses base R includes two adults raw responses 16-item Mediterranean Eating Pattern Americans (MEPA) screener. also demonstrates BMI profiles glucose measures.
code: library(essential8)  adult_data <- data.frame(   id = c("patient_1", "patient_2"),   age = c(42, 61),   sex = c("female", "male"),   diet_method = c("mepa", "mepa"),   # Daily servings   olive_oil = c(2, 1),   green_leafy_vegetables = c(1, 0.5),   other_vegetables = c(2, 1),   whole_grains = c(2, 1),   # Weekly servings   berries = c(3, 1),   other_fruit = c(5, 2),   meat = c(2, 5),   fish = c(3, 1),   chicken = c(2, 4),   cheese = c(1, 4),   butter_cream = c(1, 5),   beans = c(3, 1),   sweets_and_pastries = c(1, 5),   nuts = c(4, 1),   fast_food = c(0, 2),   alcohol = c(4, 0),   moderate_activity_minutes = c(100, 60),   vigorous_activity_minutes = c(25, 0),   smoking_status = c("never", "former"),   years_since_quit = c(0, 6),   current_inhaled_nds = c(FALSE, FALSE),   secondhand_smoke_home = c(FALSE, FALSE),   sleep_hours = c(7.5, 6.5),   bmi = c(24.2, 24.0),   bmi_profile = c("general", "asian_pacific"),   non_hdl_cholesterol = c(125, 145),   lipid_lowering_treatment = c(FALSE, TRUE),   diabetes = c(FALSE, FALSE),   glucose_measure = c("fasting_glucose", "hba1c"),   glucose_value = c(95, 6.0),   systolic_bp = c(118, 132),   diastolic_bp = c(76, 84),   antihypertensive_treatment = c(FALSE, TRUE) )

title: Get started with essential8
text: Pass data frame score_le8(). returned data frame retains input columns appends derived activity measure, eight component scores, composite score, category. Vigorous activity minutes count twice toward physical_activity_moderate_equivalent_minutes. le8_score exact, unrounded mean eight component scores. Categories "low" 50, "moderate" 50 less 80, "high" 80 higher. component scores available analysis quality checks:
code: scored <- score_le8(adult_data)  scored[c(   "id",   "mepa_total",   "le8_diet_score",   "physical_activity_moderate_equivalent_minutes",   "le8_score",   "le8_category" )] #>          id mepa_total le8_diet_score #> 1 patient_1         14             80 #> 2 patient_2          4             25 #>   physical_activity_moderate_equivalent_minutes le8_score le8_category #> 1                                           150    97.500         high #> 2                                            60    54.375     moderate component_columns <- setdiff(   grep("^le8_.*_score$", names(scored), value = TRUE),   "le8_score" )  scored[c("id", component_columns)] #>          id le8_diet_score le8_physical_activity_score le8_nicotine_score #> 1 patient_1             80                         100                100 #> 2 patient_2             25                          60                 75 #>   le8_sleep_score le8_bmi_score le8_blood_lipids_score le8_blood_glucose_score #> 1             100           100                    100                     100 #> 2              70            75                     40                      60 #>   le8_blood_pressure_score #> 1                      100 #> 2                       30

title: Get started with essential8
text: MEPA response columns use screener-item labels snake case. underscores words must match exactly, although letter case ignored. avoids silently assigning intake measurement wrong screener item. olive_oil, green_leafy_vegetables, other_vegetables, whole_grains servings per day. berries, other_fruit, meat, fish, chicken, cheese, butter_cream, beans, sweets_and_pastries, nuts, alcohol servings per week. fast_food number times per week meals consumed fast-food restaurants. screener defines meat red meat, hamburger, bacon, sausage; fish includes fish, shellfish, seafood; cheese means full-fat regular cheese cream cheese. score_le8() evaluates criterion returns sum mepa_total derived diet input can audited. alcohol criterion awards point intake zero 7 servings per week women 14 men; awards point zero applicable limit. sex column therefore required MEPA scoring accepts "female" "male" (case-insensitive).

title: Get started with essential8
text: Several LE8 inputs require explicit method choice: diet_method = "percentile", supply DASH HEI-2015 percentile 1 100 diet_value. Calculate percentile relevant reference population calling score_le8(); function rank supplied rows. diet_value need present pure-MEPA data; mixed-method data must missing MEPA rows. Set bmi_profile either "general" "asian_pacific". function infer BMI profile race ethnicity. Set glucose_measure "fasting_glucose" value mg/dL "hba1c" percentage. Diagnosed diabetes requires HbA1c scoring. Three optional, caller-adjudicated flags control clinical-judgment adjustments: apply_lean_muscular_bmi_override, apply_sleep_apnea_penalty, apply_prediabetes_metformin_penalty. columns absent, adjustments applied.

title: essential8 0.1.0
text: Added score_le8() complete adult records aged 20 years older, using eight component definitions AHA 2022 Presidential Advisory. Added raw 16-item MEPA derivation exact case-insensitive screener-column matching, optional explicit column mappings, auditable mepa_total, population-percentile diet scoring. Added moderate-equivalent activity minutes, general Asian-Pacific BMI profiles, explicit glucose-measure selection. Added manually scored 10-subject example data set, AHA worked-example tests, cut-point, modifier, compound-condition, validation tests. Added reproducible Get Started vignette.
